submission.natural_language_explanation: Fires on a bare single-digit numeral token ' 1' (strongest, ~0.7-1.0 of max) or ' 2' (~0.4-0.5; ' 3' and higher digits weak, ' 7'/' 9' near zero) when it directly follows a quantity hedge or bound such as 'more/fewer than', 'over', 'at least', 'up to', 'nearly', 'almost', 'about', 'approximately', 'roughly' or 'a total of' (milder after 'by', 'exactly', 'at most'), i.e. the leading digit of an approximate or bounded quantity like 'more than 1 year' or 'nearly 1,000'. It is silent on the same digit with no preceding quantifier ('lost 1,000 items', 'Chapter 1', 'page 1', '1999'), on spelled-out or multi-digit-token numbers ('a mile', ' 10', ' 100'), on all other tokens, and there is no floor on the first token or on prompts without such a numeral.
